incidents.name: Claude for Microsoft 365 add-in missing for some users

incident_updates.body: Our upstream provider has applied a mitigation for the issue that caused the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account, and we are monitoring for recovery. If Claude is still missing, try adding it again from Microsoft Marketplace, or use the web versions of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint at office.com, where Claude remains available for many users. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

We have identified an issue with an upstream provider that is causing the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account. We are in contact with them. In the meantime, we recommend using the web versions of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint at office.com, where Claude remains available for many users. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

We are continuing to investigate an issue causing the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account. In the meantime, we recommend using the web versions of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint at office.com, where Claude remains available for many users. Work and school accounts do not appear affected. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

We are investigating an issue causing the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account. Work and school accounts do not appear affected, and Claude's other apps are unaffected. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

updates.body: The issue affecting claude.ai has been resolved. Impact occurred from 02:20 PT / 10:20 UTC to 02:40 PT / 10:40 UTC.
A fix has been deployed for the issue affecting Claude services and we are monitoring for recovery.
We have identified the cause of elevated errors on requests to Claude Fable 5.2 and are working on a fix. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

We have identified an issue which affected Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Mythos 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 from 20:52 PT on November 24 / 04:52 UTC on November 25 to 21:16 PT on November 24 / 05:16 UTC on November 25, resulting in elevated errors. This issue has been resolved.
The issue affecting Claude services has been resolved. Impact occurred from 09:09 PT / 17:09 UTC to 09:27 PT / 17:27 UTC.
A fix has been deployed for the issue affecting Claude services and we are monitoring for recovery.
We are investigating elevated errors on requests to Claude Haiku 5.5. We will provide an update as soon as possible.
